ItemID: NA; Title: 25; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Expressive vocals appeal to me, but I would choose orchestral or duet recordings this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Partners; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Vocal duets fit my interest in A Musical Affair and polished, melodic singing.
ItemID: NA; Title: Oscd Ad Adele 21; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The vocal focus sounds appealing, but it is less close to my current classical crossover mood.
ItemID: NA; Title: Glen Campbell: Greatest Hits; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Melodic country songs fit the side of my listening reflected in Golden and 747.
ItemID: NA; Title: Same Trailer Different Park; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am looking for sweeping vocals or relaxing arrangements rather than country storytelling right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Duets II; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Classic songs and paired voices suit my interest in Stages and vocal ensemble recordings.
ItemID: NA; Title: In The Lonely Hour; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Intimate contemporary pop is less appealing right now than theatrical vocals and orchestral music.
ItemID: NA; Title: 21 Number Ones; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: A country hits collection could fit my listening, but I would try the Glen Campbell collection first.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Very Best of Frankie Valli & The 4 Seasons Single; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Older melodic vocal music interests me, but I would prioritize the duet albums today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Title; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone gives me too little reason to expect the orchestral or vocal music I want.
